correction: The first account identified the Java USymbol invariant correctly but assigned the Rust divergence to the component-backed DESCRIPTION path. Valid brace-delimited storage and artifact sources select Rust's Deployment subtype, whose parser already retains DeploymentNodeKind::Storage and DeploymentNodeKind::Artifact. The shipped divergence is in deployment cluster rendering and painted-envelope accounting, not parser identity erasure.

included: Brace-delimited DESCRIPTION storage containers on the Deployment model
Brace-delimited DESCRIPTION artifact containers on the Deployment model
Cluster shape dispatch, title placement, LimitFinder envelope translation, and canvas extent

invariant: The Deployment parser's retained node kind selects one coherent Java USymbol model for cluster layout and painting. Storage asBig paints a round-70 URectangle with cluster stroke width 1, places stereotype content at top offset 5 and title content at top offset 7 plus stereotype height, and contributes URectangle LimitFinder bounds (-1,-1,width-1,height-1). Artifact asBig paints its rounded URectangle and folded-page glyph with cluster stroke width 1, places both text blocks at top offset 2, and contributes combined LimitFinder bounds (-1,-1,width+5,height-1): the URectangle supplies the negative minima and the UPolygon ten-pixel X expansion supplies width+5. SvekResult translates the measured minima to 6 and derives its canvas from the measured maxima plus 15.
causal_divergence: Rust parsing already retains both exact kinds. Artifact cluster painting also already uses the artifact primitive. Storage is omitted from emit_cluster_shape and falls through to the default node tag polygon. Storage is also omitted from its Java-specific title offsets. Both Storage and Artifact are omitted from deployment_cluster_frame's root-cluster painted bounds, so their URectangle minimum is treated as zero instead of -1; artifact's polygon-expanded maximum width+5 is also lost. The fallback frame consequently places the solved cluster at 6 instead of 7 and derives oversized fallback canvases. These omissions explain the complete preserved residual cluster, including storage's wrong primitive and title position and artifact's uniform one-pixel translation, without reference to fixture labels or tuned output coordinates.

preserved_evidence.storage_observation: The Java SVG paints rx=ry=35 at x=y=7 on a 159x98 canvas. The frozen Rust helper paints a node polygon at the fallback frame on a 169x108 canvas.
preserved_evidence.artifact_observation: The artifact primitive dimensions are already correct, but every painted coordinate is one pixel low and left at x=y=6 and the fallback canvas is 215x128 instead of 211x118.

planned_change: Keep the existing parser and DeploymentNodeKind model. Route Storage cluster painting to a cluster-stroke variant of the existing storage primitive. Split cluster stereotype and title baseline offsets so Storage implements y=5/y=7 while Artifact retains y=2/y=2. Extend deployment_cluster_frame's root cluster bounds with the Java-derived Storage and Artifact LimitFinder bounds, using the same bounds for minimum translation and maximum canvas extent. Add model tests with renamed labels, stereotypes, colors, directions, nesting, and sibling controls. Do not alter layout coordinates after rendering, key behavior to fixture text, or introduce constants derived only from SVG differences.
